collection.description: Two partners love each other but disagree about having a baby.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Two partners love each other but disagree about having a baby. Neither wants to lose the relationship, and neither wants a decision made out of guilt.

choices.label: Ask a Trusted Elder to Listen
Discuss Other Ways to Care for Children

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They understand each other better, even without agreement.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They recognize their futures may not fit together.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: They agree on a date to revisit it without pressure.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The delay becomes frustrating, and they acknowledge it.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The elder helps them talk without deciding for them.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The elder takes a side, and they end the conversation.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: They find meaningful roles with younger villagers.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They discover those roles do not resolve their disagreement.
